text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Maruzensky—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
A crane game, huh! They've been pretty 
popular lately, haven't they?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I used to play it a lot, but... once you 
get the hang of it, the thrill just 
disappears!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Look, look~ That plushie is super 
cute~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Stuffed plushies shaped like Umamusume 
were on display there as crane game 
prizes.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, I really want that one~. Could 
you win it for me?
choice_data_list:
Aren't you supposed to be good at crane 
games?
I thought you were good at crane games?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Jeez, Trainer-kun, you really don't 
understand a maiden's heart at all...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Jeez, Trainer-chan, you really don't 
understand a maiden's heart at all...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Taking it yourself versus having someone 
hand it to you makes totally different 
statements, right?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Do your best! Trainer-kun! I'm counting on 
you♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Do your best! Trainer-chan! I'm counting 
on you♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
